name: [NEW] POPPING IN 🐟
desc:
🌿 **Empang Indo - Fish Farming Simulator** 🐟

Welcome to **Empang Indo!** Build your own angler and become the best fish breeder.

🐟 **Cultivator of various types of fish**
From cheap fish like **Lele and Nila**, to rare fish like **Betutu, Piranha and Arowana**.


🐟 **Starting from seed**
Buy fish seedlings, put them in the pond, wait until big, then harvest to get money.

💰 **Develop your handle**
Upgrade ponds, unlock new fish, and upgrade your level to get more expensive fish.

🌧 **Rare fish & special event**
Some fish only appear in certain conditions like when it rains!

⭐ **Level up and become a master**
The higher your level, the more types of fish you can keep.

Build the biggest yam and become the **Yam King in Indo Yam!** 🐟
